inspection_scope: Phase 2.2 masks and side-by-side review images

improvements: closed gemstone outline remains aligned with the visible stone perimeter
shank silhouette follows the left and right band
four separate prong regions are retained
remaining_errors: prong masks are oversized and rounded compared with the metal tips
setting and lower shadow ownership remains coarse
gemstone boundary is image-guided but not human-verified

improvements: outer and inner shank boundaries align well with the reference
remaining_errors: three visible prong fragments do not identify hidden prongs

improvements: four-prong topology and shank silhouette are stable
stone perimeter is closed and scale-consistent with the front view
remaining_errors: prong regions remain larger than the observed tips
setting boundary near the stone is not pixel-accurate

improvements: outer shank silhouette follows the oblique band
stone is represented by one closed region
remaining_errors: foreshortened stone outline is still too prior-driven
setting absorbs part of the right shoulder
floor shadow is incomplete and semantically uncertain

improvements: inner and outer shank contours align well
basket and shank remain structurally separated
remaining_errors: single visible prong aggregate cannot recover four hidden identities
stone depth and hidden seat cannot be validated from this image

conclusion: Phase 2.2 is suitable as an annotation and reconstruction initializer, but not as ground truth. Human-reviewed component boundaries are the next required gate before reporting IoU, Dice, boundary F1, or manufacturing-level CAD accuracy.
